CustomField.description: Stamped every time the Pending Customer Signature email goes out, by the record-triggered flow on the first send and by the daily reminder flow on each resend. This is what the reminder counts from - Last_Status_Sync__c moves on every poll and Sent_To_Bank_Date__c never moves, so neither can tell the reminder when it last wrote to the customer. Written only by those two flows.
CustomField.label: Pending Signature Email Sent Date
